title: Machine Learning Approaches on High Throughput NGS Data to Unveil Mechanisms of Function in Biology and Disease.
authors: Pezoulas, Vasileios C; Hazapis, Orsalia; Lagopati, Nefeli; Exarchos, Themis P; Goules, Andreas V; Tzioufas, Athanasios G; Fotiadis, Dimitrios I; Stratis, Ioannis G; Yannacopoulos, Athanasios N; Gorgoulis, Vassilis G
one_liner_zh: 综述机器学习在NGS组学数据中的应用，涵盖TF结合位点预测等生物机制解析，但内容宽泛、非聚焦TF-DNA互作建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: In this review, the fundamental basis of machine learning (ML) and data mining (DM) are summarized together with the techniques for distilling knowledge from state-of-the-art omics experiments. This includes an introduction to the basic mathematical principles of unsupervised/supervised learning methods, dimensionality reduction techniques, deep neural networks architectures and the applications of these in bioinformatics. Several case studies under evaluation mainly involve next generation sequencing (NGS) experiments, like deciphering gene expression from total and single cell (scRNA-seq) analysis; for the latter, a description of all recent artificial intelligence (AI) methods for the investigation of cell sub-types, biomarkers and imputation techniques are described. Other areas of interest where various ML schemes have been investigated are for providing information regarding transcription factors (TF) binding sites, chromatin organization patterns and RNA binding proteins (RBPs), while analyses on RNA sequence and structure as well as 3D dimensional protein structure predictions with the use of ML are described. Furthermore, we summarize the recent methods of using ML in clinical oncology, when taking into consideration the current omics data with pharmacogenomics to determine personalized treatments. With this review we wish to provide the scientific community with a thorough investigation of main novel ML applications which take into consideration the latest achievements in genomics, thus, unraveling the fundamental mechanisms of biology towards the understanding and cure of diseases.
abstract_zh: 在这篇综述中，我们总结了机器学习（ML）和数据挖掘（DM）的基本原理，以及从最先进的组学实验中提取知识的技术。这包括对无监督/有监督学习方法的基本数学原理、降维技术、深度神经网络架构及其在生物信息学中的应用的介绍。评估中的几个案例研究主要涉及下一代测序（NGS）实验，如从总体和单细胞（scRNA-seq）分析中解读基因表达；对于后者，描述了所有近期用于研究细胞亚型、生物标志物和插补技术的人工智能（AI）方法。其他感兴趣的领域包括利用各种ML方案提供关于转录因子（TF）结合位点、染色质组织模式和RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）的信息，同时描述了利用ML进行RNA序列和结构分析以及三维蛋白质结构预测的研究。此外，我们总结了在考虑当前组学数据与药物基因组学以确定个性化治疗时，ML在临床肿瘤学中的最新应用方法。通过这篇综述，我们希望为科学界提供对主要新型ML应用的深入调查，这些应用考虑了基因组学的最新成就，从而揭示生物学的基本机制，以促进对疾病的理解和治愈。
